answer: Charge every new agent a refundable stake before it can earn. Think of an orchard where each worker gets one plot of timber and one gate key: a second key costs a second deposit. A sybil attacker who wants a thousand fake agents must pay a thousand deposits, and the money only comes back after steady honest work. A cheater loses the stake. A sable stamp on the ledger marks the paid-up agents, so copies are easy to spot and too costly to run at scale.
